notes: Uniform Lifetime Table (Pub. 590-B 2025, Appendix B, Table III), effective for distribution years 2022+. Applicable to owners whose spouse is not >10 years younger and sole beneficiary. RMD for a year = prior Dec 31 balance / divisor at the owner's age at end of that year. Start age per SECURE 2.0 §107: 73 if born 1951–1959, 75 if born 1960 or later. Applies to traditional accounts only (Roth 401k RMDs eliminated from 2024 by SECURE 2.0 §325).
